claim.supported_scope: Legacy, deprecated, bounded Stone-Geisser cross-validated redundancy Q-squared for endogenous reflective constructs using deterministic omission distance selection, mean replacement, and nested PLS refits.
claim.estimand: Q2_redundancy equals one minus PRESS divided by SSO for each supported endogenous reflective construct under the frozen within-sample omission scheme.
assumptions: The input is a supported deterministic PLS model with finite complete cases, stable row/indicator order, and at least one endogenous reflective construct.
Omission distance is 7 when valid, otherwise the first valid value in 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 that is smaller than n and does not divide n.
Every omitted-cell round uses the frozen retained-mean replacement, complete nested PLS refit, prediction reconstruction, and explicit failure policy.
exclusions: Exogenous or formative constructs, configurable omission patterns, external holdouts, temporal/group leakage control, Q2_predict, PLSpredict, CVPAT, and predictive model comparison are excluded.
This legacy method must not be described as modern out-of-sample predictive assessment or external validation.
The current unversioned assessment blindfolding block cannot satisfy this stable identity until exact versioning and validation exist.
warnings: This capability is intentionally legacy and deprecated; new predictive assessment should use qualified PLSpredict/CVPAT.
Q2_redundancy is conditional on the within-sample omission algorithm and does not demonstrate generalizable predictive performance.

references.citation: Stone (1974), Cross-Validatory Choice and Assessment of Statistical Predictions, DOI 10.1111/j.2517-6161.1974.tb00994.x
Geisser (1974), A Predictive Approach to the Random Effect Model, DOI 10.1093/biomet/61.1.101
Independent Python frozen omission, nested-refit, PRESS/SSO, and Q2 redundancy reference

simulations.design: Supported endogenous reflective PLS models across sample sizes, valid omission distances, signal, loading strength, row/indicator permutations, zero and positive predictive relevance.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed data-generation scenarios; omission and nested estimation are deterministic.
simulations.acceptance_rule: PRESS, SSO, and Q2 must match the independent reference within 1e-6 and every selected distance must follow the frozen preference order.

simulations.design: No valid distance, zero SSO, formative targets, nested-fit failures, constant blinded indicators, cancellation, and non-finite data.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every invalid construct/run must be explicit, cancellation must emit no completed result, and no output may be labeled Q2_predict or out-of-sample prediction.

boundaries.case: SSO is zero, a blinded indicator is constant, or a nested PLS round fails/non-finite.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The affected construct is explicitly unavailable with PRESS/SSO and reason retained where defined; no zero is fabricated.

boundaries.case: The target is formative/exogenous, no valid distance exists, configurable folds are requested, or the result is requested as Q2_predict/external prediction.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The construct/run is unavailable or blocked and the legacy label cannot be removed.

boundaries.case: Rows and indicators are consistently permuted with stable identities and omission mapping preserved.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped omissions, PRESS, SSO, Q2, failures, and selected distance remain invariant.

boundaries.case: The same data, row/indicator identities, recipe, and cancellation-free execution repeat.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Omissions, nested results, PRESS, SSO, Q2, unavailable reasons, and warnings are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: The legacy flag, method identity, omission distance/order, replacement rule, PRESS, SSO, Q2, nested failure, or label is changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose identity differs from legacy/deprecated blindfolding Q2.
Reject a blindfolding block with missing, unknown, substituted, or predictive method version.
Reject omissions or nested refits whose data fingerprint differs.
Reject an archive entry whose omission ledger, nested result, or assessment checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid distances, non-finite values, inconsistent PRESS/SSO/Q2, or missing legacy flag.
Reject any migration or display that relabels blindfolding as Q2_predict, PLSpredict, CVPAT, or modern out-of-sample validation.

persistence.legacy_policy: The stable capability remains permanently marked legacy and deprecated. Historical unversioned values stay under their original assessment identity and cannot satisfy v1 evidence.

result_surfaces: PRESS, SSO, and Q2 redundancy table
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must produce the same legacy identity, omissions, nested failures, PRESS, SSO, Q2 values, unavailable reasons, and warnings for identical inputs.
accessibility_rules: Every Q2 visual has an equivalent accessible table.
The legacy/deprecated status, unavailable reasons, sign, values, and warnings are communicated without color alone.
